summary: High-resolution timer elapsed-time query. Reads the previous timestamp stored at this+0x20/0x24, dispatches a fresh timestamp through QueryPerformanceCounterWrapperWithModeDispatch, stores the new timestamp back to those fields, and converts the tick delta to seconds using the frequency word at this+0x0 and the reciprocal scaling factor at this+0x8.

operations.description: Read previous timestamp low part from this+0x20.
Read previous timestamp high part from this+0x24.
Query the current performance counter timestamp through QueryPerformanceCounterWrapperWithModeDispatch, writing low part and high part.
Compute 64-bit delta as current timestamp minus previous timestamp.
Store current timestamp low part back to this+0x20.
Store current timestamp high part back to this+0x24.
Read timer frequency low word at this+0x0 and divide the delta low part by it.
Multiply the delta high part by the reciprocal scaling factor at this+0x8 and add the low-part quotient to obtain elapsed seconds.
Return the computed elapsed time in seconds.

unresolved: Exact signed/unsigned treatment of the delta high part in the returned expression depends on how the dispatcher packs the timestamp; not resolvable from this packet alone.
